name: Three_Phase_Diesel
description: Three-phase diesel generator with AC output measurements, engine monitoring, and operating controls.

P.name: Rated AC Voltage
P.description: Rated line-to-line voltage at the three-phase generator output.

P.name: Rated AC Current
P.description: Rated AC output current per line at the specified operating rating.

P.name: Fuel Tank Capacity
P.description: Fuel tank capacity specified for the generator.

P.name: Rated Frequency
P.description: Rated frequency of the generator's AC output.

P.name: Fuel Consumption Rate
P.description: Fuel consumed per unit of electrical energy generated at the specified reference load.

M.name: Fuel Level
M.description: Fuel remaining as a percentage of tank capacity. Map only a percentage reading or a calibrated conversion.

M.name: Coolant Temperature
M.description: Engine coolant temperature in degrees Celsius. Convert the source temperature unit when mapping.

M.name: Start Stop Status
M.description: Reported engine running state: Stopped or Running.

enumData.label: Stopped
enumData.description: The mapped status source reports that the device is stopped. Read this state from a confirmed status signal.

enumData.label: Running
enumData.description: The mapped status source reports that the device is running. Check power measurements separately to determine its actual output.

M.name: Engine Load
M.description: Engine load percentage reported by the generator controller.

M.name: AC Power
M.description: Total AC active power across the configured generator output. Positive from the generator toward the AC system; negative for reverse power into the generator. Normalize the source sign when mapping. The total covers all three phases.

M.name: AC Frequency
M.description: Frequency measured at the generator's AC output.

M.name: L1 Voltage
M.description: AC output voltage measured between L1 and neutral.

M.name: L2 Voltage
M.description: AC output voltage measured between L2 and neutral.

M.name: L3 Voltage
M.description: AC output voltage measured between L3 and neutral.

M.name: L1 Current
M.description: AC output current measured on L1.

M.name: L2 Current
M.description: AC output current measured on L2.

M.name: L3 Current
M.description: AC output current measured on L3.

M.name: L1 Active Power
M.description: AC active power on L1. Positive from the generator toward the AC system; negative for reverse power into the generator. Normalize the source sign when mapping.

M.name: L2 Active Power
M.description: AC active power on L2. Positive from the generator toward the AC system; negative for reverse power into the generator. Normalize the source sign when mapping.

M.name: L3 Active Power
M.description: AC active power on L3. Positive from the generator toward the AC system; negative for reverse power into the generator. Normalize the source sign when mapping.

M.name: AC Energy Total
M.description: Cumulative AC energy generated at the generator output.

M.name: AC Daily Energy
M.description: AC energy generated during the current day, calculated by the EMS from the change in M131 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at local midnight. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Weekly Energy
M.description: AC energy generated during the current week, calculated by the EMS from the change in M131 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at the configured calendar-week boundary. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Monthly Energy
M.description: AC energy generated during the current month, calculated by the EMS from the change in M131 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on the first day of the calendar month. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Quarterly Energy
M.description: AC energy generated during the current quarter, calculated by the EMS from the change in M131 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1, April 1, July 1, or October 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Yearly Energy
M.description: AC energy generated during the current calendar year, calculated by the EMS from the change in M131 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires annual aggregation support and a valid year-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

A.name: Start

enumData.label: Start
enumData.description: Request the device to start through its configured control route. Confirm the outcome using the Start Stop Status measurement.

A.description: Request the diesel generator to start.

A.name: Stop

enumData.label: Stop
enumData.description: Request the device to stop through its configured control route. Confirm the outcome using the Start Stop Status measurement.

A.description: Request the diesel generator to stop.

A.name: Power Set
A.description: Request a power setpoint for the generator electrical output.

A.name: Clear Error

enumData.label: Reset Fault
enumData.description: Request a fault reset through the configured control route. Check the device fault or alarm feedback to confirm the outcome.

A.description: Request a fault reset on the diesel generator.
